Rajasthan Officials Investigated in Villa Scam, Wife Removed from Post

Rajasthan's Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) is investigating IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal and his wife, IPS officer Prashakha Mathur, in connection with a villa scam. The couple allegedly purchased 40 villas in two and a half years. As a result of the ACB probe, Mathur has been removed from her post, and both officers have been placed on 'APO' (awaiting posting order) status by the Rajasthan government. Agrawal holds a B.Tech degree, and Mathur holds an MBBS degree.
